limits: Upstream Python includes inherited and client-only tests.
Full batch acceptance and the remaining Spark SDP crosswalk are outstanding.
LakeCat profile uses MemoryCatalogStore, AllowAllGovernanceEngine and local file storage; no durability, credential-vending, restart, authentication or distributed-cluster qualification.
The optional embedded LakeCatCatalogProvider is not exercised; REST interoperability does not require aligning its older Sail Rust dependency with this client.
LakeCat standard view-create routes remain unavailable; Sail Iceberg REST view replacement also remains unsupported. These table cases do not qualify persisted views.
The 124 pytest cases comprise 98 pipeline cases, 14 earlier shared regressions, 10 partition/write DDL cases and two new direct Iceberg schema API cases.

retained_failures.cause: LakeCat stored the correct Iceberg doc; Sail did not expose that doc as common Arrow comment metadata.
